0022600120.text: The Timberwolves (3-0, 3rd in the Northwest, 6th in the West) visit the Cavaliers (1-1, 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back, 9th in the East) for Minnesota's fourth game of the season, riding a three-game winning streak and a 2-0 road record. Donte DiVincenzo is out after Achilles surgery, and he averaged 12.2 points in 30.4 minutes per game last season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, and their last meeting was on January 10, 2026, in Cleveland, where Minnesota lost 146-134.
